cases.purpose: Observe addr-success with independent request capture and kernel readback.
cases.oracle: Guest setup checks QEMU UUID, mapped uid, distinct user and network namespaces and CAP_NET_ADMIN. A native ioctl tracee independently controls address, mask, flags, route, EEXIST, ENETUNREACH, ENODEV and EPERM; request bytes and returns are captured by a separately compiled ptrace observer. Each candidate runs inside this same private namespace with marker-delimited ioctl capture, recorded status, output and independent ip/proc/ioctl readback. Dropped-capability cases verify the post-exec capability state. Setup controls and parser/assertion controls are per case.
cases.comparison: Assess exact ioctl count, order, argument fields and return errno, candidate status and diagnostics, and relevant before/after kernel state. Timeout, output and trace limits are candidate failures with retained partial observations. A separate primary evidence gate must reject missing, malformed or truncated control/observation diagnostics and incomplete controls.
